entities.name: Cullinarn
entities.description: Master of the House of Oor-tael in Estark on Dominaria and father of Garth One-eye; a master of invisibility killed in the Night of Fire.

entities.name: Garth One-eye
entities.description: Cullinarn's son, who later lived in his father's winter palace.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: Grand Master and Master of Arena, Cullinarn's friend, whom Cullinarn once saved from an assassin.

entities.name: House of Oor-tael
entities.description: House in Estark led by Cullinarn.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: The storming of Oor-tael in which Cullinarn was killed.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where the House of Oor-tael stood.

entities.name: Gish
entities.description: Place in the Southlands near Cullinarn's winter palace.

events.summary: Cullinarn saves Kuthuman from an assassin in his youth.
events.quote: he had saved the life of his friend, Grand Master Kuthuman , from an assassin

events.summary: Cullinarn resists Kuthuman's order for Oor-tael to surrender its blue and green mana.
events.quote: He resisted Kuthuman when the Master of Arena ordered Oor-tael to surrender its blue and green mana

events.summary: Zarel convinces Kuthuman to ally with the other House Masters and storm Oor-tael.
events.quote: Zarel then convinced Kuthuman to ally with the other House Masters and storm the building of Oor-tael.

events.summary: Cullinarn is killed in the Night of Fire.
events.quote: Cullinarn was killed in the subsequent Night of Fire .

relations.quote: Cullinarn was the master of the House of Oor-tael in Estark
